summary: Taiwan, open source software developer, strong advocate for Free Software, reverse engineering enthusiast, active in FLOSS community, interested in hardware support for Linux, engaged in Debian project, expertise in Linux kernel and firmware, involved in open hardware projects, supports Software Freedom Conservancy, participates in open source mentorship programs, follows developments in open source licensing, interested in reproducible builds, advocates for transparency in open source funding, engaged in discussions about software freedom and proprietary software issues.
